text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The veteran Wonder Acute! And Tomakomai's 
rising star, Hokko Tarumae!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The first fierce battle across generations 
has come to an end! The other Umamusume 
gave it their all as well!

"It didn't look like a meaningless match 
at all. Under the setting sun, it was a 
fierce battle where neither side gave an 
inch."

Wonder Acute ran with plenty to spare; it 
didn't look at all like the running of an 
Umamusume who had decided to retire.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much, Acute-san!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I... I think I understand a little now! 
The burning passion of running on dirt!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"So Falco-san and Acute-san have been 
running like this all along..."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
No, all the seniors who ran before us 
burned their very souls to the absolute 
limit!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae-chan...? Pushing herself... to the 
absolute limit...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I understand a little better now... But 
today... I still feel like it wasn't quite 
enough...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I want to feel it much, much more! Not 
just feel it, but fire up my Tomakomai 
spirit with a hearty heaved-ho!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I want to surpass Acute-san, whom I 
respect with all my heart... and become 
the strongest, greatest Uma Musume ever!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Respects me... from the bottom of her 
heart...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Respect...
Just then, off in the distance...

Wonder Acute's figure seemed to waver 
faintly in the evening twilight.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Acute-san, could we please go for one more 
match?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Next time, in one month, at the Champions 
Cup!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: The Champions Cup, huh...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Sure, sounds good to me~. Totally fine~.

—Wonder Acute readily agreed, and came 
back home.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I'm home, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Acute, are you sure about that?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Huh? It's fine... what is, exactly?
choice_data_list: Did you just say the "Champions Cup"?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Yeah, you're right. Tarumae-chan 
pointed it out, so I just kinda...
choice_data_list: Why did you agree to it?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Umm, that would be...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't know. But I've already sent my 
reply, so..."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, could you keep me company for 
just a little longer?

I didn't pry any deeper. I was too afraid 
to ask more than that. However...

Something might be beginning to change 
within Wonder Acute. Heading into the 
Champions Cup, something...
